normalized_matching_profile.name: The Hammock House
normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents… “The Hammock House”, your dream getaway in Seagrove Beach. Feel the breeze as you unwind on screened porches, sip your morning coffee under the sun, or cruise to the beach with the 4 bikes provided. With 2 sparkling community pools and a cozy patio for evening chats, this charming home invites you to slow down, soak in the moment, and truly relax. Whether it’s a lazy beach day or an adventure-filled escape, this is where unforgettable memories begin! Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Steps to the Beach: Just a short 5-minute stroll or bike ride brings you to Seagrove’s stunning white sands—feel the ocean breeze and soak up the sun in no time.2 Pools On-Site: Take a refreshing dip in one of two sparkling community pools—perfect for cooling off after a beach day or relaxing under the Florida sun.Stylish Outdoor Living: Enjoy the charm of screened porches for those breezy mornings or host a cozy al fresco dinner on the private, beautifully paved patio.Spacious Layout: The open-concept living, dining, and kitchen areas create a welcoming space ideal for family bonding, laughter with friends, or simply unwinding in comfort.Proximity to Everything: Perfectly located near Seaside, Watercolor, and the best of 30A’s dining and shopping scene—immerse yourself in the heart of coastal life.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "The location was absolutely perfect, and the house was stunning! Everything was spotless, and the kitchen had everything we could possibly need—so well-stocked!" – Mekesha M.⭐ "A beautiful home with incredibly comfortable bedding and plenty of extra blankets! We especially enjoyed the screened porch for cozy family evenings." – Diana K.⭐ "This house is nothing short of breathtaking and had everything we could ask for. Close to the beach and town, yet so peaceful—perfect for pure relaxation." – Lynley S.*** LIVING AREA ***Experience the perfect blend of comfort and sophistication in a bright, open living space designed for meaningful connections with family and friends. Plush seating and a spacious layout invite you to relax and recharge, making it the ultimate retreat after a sun-filled day.Spacious open-concept layout filled with abundant natural lightLuxurious plush seating that exudes a cozy coastal charmSeamlessly connected to a screened porch for effortless indoor-outdoor living*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Cook like a chef in a fully equipped, state-of-the-art kitchen stocked with everything you need to create your favorite dishes effortlessly. Then, gather around a spacious, beautifully designed dining table to savor your meals while creating unforgettable memories with loved ones.Sleek stainless steel appliances paired with generous counter space for effortless meal prepStylish bar seating for 4, complemented by a spacious dining table for 8—perfect for gatheringsFully stocked kitchen with premium cookware, elegant dishes, and essential small appliances for every need*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Experience the joy of outdoor living with ample space to relax, dine, or enjoy your morning coffee in peace. The beautifully designed backyard patio and screened porches offer the perfect blend of comfort, style, and privacy, creating your own serene retreat.Unwind on the screened side porch, where you can bask in the soothing beach breeze and enjoy your morning coffee or evening relaxationSavor outdoor dining on the charming paved patio, featuring cozy seating, a BBQ grill, and the perfect ambiance for gatheringsLocated in a tranquil community with picturesque walking paths, ideal for peaceful strolls and reconnecting with nature*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Immerse yourself in the ultimate combination of comfort and sophistication with expansive, meticulously designed bedrooms that exude tranquility and sleek, contemporary bathrooms crafted with precision to redefine relaxation and rejuvenation at every touch.1st Floor:Luxury Primary King Suite: Relax in a spacious king-size bed with a private en-suite featuring dual sinks and a walk-in shower. Enjoy direct access to the serene screened porch for your morning coffee or evening unwind.Convenient Guest Bathroom: A stylish hallway bathroom with a walk-in shower, perfect for shared use and easy access for guests.2nd Floor:Elegant King Guest Suite: Rest comfortably in a king-size bed with convenient access to a beautifully designed shared bathroom.Fun & Functional Bunk Room: Ideal for families, this room features 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds, comfortably sleeping up to four. A perfect spot for kids to relax and make memories!Modern Shared Bathroom: Features a sleek single sink and a walk-in shower, thoughtfully located for easy access by all upstairs bedrooms.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Seagrove Beach is a vibrant, picturesque community along 30A, celebrated for its stunning natural beauty and warm, welcoming vibe. Here, adventure and relaxation go hand in hand. Explore scenic biking trails that weave through lush landscapes, or indulge in unforgettable dining experiences at local gems like Café Thirty-A and Surfing Deer. From tranquil beach days to lively evenings out, Seagrove Beach offers something special for every visitor, making it the perfect destination to create cherished memories.Seagrove Beach Access (11-minute walk): Your perfect spot for sun, sand, and relaxation—soak up the laid-back coastal vibes just minutes from your door.Seaside (6-minute drive): Explore this charming and vibrant town filled with boutique shopping, delicious dining, and lively local events that capture the essence of coastal living.Grayton Beach State Park (11-minute drive): Immerse yourself in nature with scenic hiking trails, pristine beaches, and breathtaking views—a peaceful escape for outdoor enthusiasts.Nearby Restaurants: Old Florida Fish House and Market Café serve up fresh seafood and casual, welcoming atmospheres—ideal for a relaxed meal after a day of adventure.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 22776STRO #: STR-022776
